text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein receives Turkish State Minister Ahmet Cemil Tunc.
- U.N. sanctions committee approves 13 more medical and food contracts.
- Egypt to hold pharmaceutical exhibition in Baghdad at the end of April.
- Iraq and Jordan discuss agricultural cooperation.
- Vice-Chairman of the Revolutionary Command Council holds meeting with Baath party leaders in the southern province of Missan.
- Air force academy celebrates graduation of a new batch of pilots.
- Preparations continue for celebrating Saddam's birthday on April 28.
(The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ and QADISSIYA)
- Editorial praises Saddam's leadership of Iraq and the ruling Baath party.
- Commentary urges Arabs to take a decisive stand vis-a-vis Israeli policies in occupied territories.
- Article on how the youth are perceived in Saddam's thinking.
- Editorial denies presence of Kuwaiti prisoners in Iraq.
- Commentary urges U.N. Security Council to honour its commitments towards Iraq and remove the oil embargo.
- Article on the benefits to be gained by sticking to the economic guidelines laid out by Saddam last year.
